messages.subject: for in function
parts:
i'd like to calculate, by using a function, if the classes variables
in a data.frame are "integer" or not.

the following comand line

for (i in 1:ncol(comportamenti)) (class(comportamenti[,i])=="integer")

did not display any results, while the command line shown below

for (i in 1:ncol(comportamenti)) print(class(comportamenti[,i])
=="integer")

did print the informations but did not allow to organize them as a
vector.

how can i get a vecor output to then select only the columns which
class is "integer"


thanks for help

messages.author: 3edc58ee737edd94
messages.subject: Re: [CorpLing with R] for in function
parts:
Like this?

# create a data frame
x<-1:10
y<-letters[1:10]
z<-rnorm(10)
df<-data.frame(x,y,z)

# apply to each column the function is.integer and use the resulting truth values for subsetting
df[,sapply(df, is.integer)]
